ValidationRule.description:
When ESO ISR is cloned and before Save…
Status - should be “ESO Draft”
ESO Selection - will be empty
ESO Business Unit will be empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( ISCLONE(), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "ESO_Support_Request", OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"ESO Draft")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(ESO_Selection__c,"")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c,"")) ) )
/*AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "ESO Support Request", ISCLONE(), ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'ESO Draft')), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ESO_Selection__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Business_Unit__c))) ) )*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields need changes: Status - change to “ESO Draft” ESO Selection - Change to empty ESO Business Unit - Change to empty
